text: おとなの　せかいに　くびを　つっこむと　あぶないぜ！

structure.jp: おとなの　せかいに
くびを　つっこむと
structure.en: if you stick your neck in

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.span: つっこむと　あぶない
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'if you do this, that follows every time'. つっこむと　あぶない = 'if you stick it in, it's dangerous'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy speech that adds 'I tell you'. あぶないぜ = 'it's dangerous, you know!'
